svg.title: Six additional KronTerm OS icon styles
svg.desc: Official icons compared across Phosphor Regular and Duotone, Heroicons Outline and Solid, Fluent Regular, and Bootstrap.

g.text: Six more styles. Official package SVGs at 32 px; native geometry, weights and duotone opacity preserved.
Same eight OS roles · all genuine SVG assets · no application icons changed
Labels beneath glyphs show source asset names. Heroicons uses cpu-chip for Agent; Fluent uses prompt for Terminal.
